effect.name: LCD Grid
effect.description: The handheld screen itself: a dot-matrix grid with a gap between cells and a tinted backlight. Sits on top of a finished frame and makes it look like it is being read off a panel rather than drawn on one.
effect.author: CyberMushroom

parameter.name: Backlight
parameter.description: Colour the panel glows. Default is DMG 155,188,15.

parameter.name: Gap Width
parameter.description: How much of each cell is gap rather than lit area.

parameter.name: Gap Darkness
parameter.description: How dark the gaps go. Past about 0.5 the image starts to disappear at small cell sizes.

parameter.name: Backlight Tint
parameter.description: Pushes the whole image toward the backlight colour, the way a DMG panel washes everything green.
